Private artifact storage backends.

Generated assets are untrusted until the gateway has structurally validated them,
and downloads are revalidated against the database checksum before being served.
Storage implementations never create public URLs.

Atomic job admission, ownership, leases, and persistence.

Non-idempotent upstream POSTs are never retried automatically. A lost response
cannot prove that no GPU work was accepted. Those jobs retain their quota slot
until an operator reconciles them with the actual upstream service.

Fail-closed external JWT/JWKS validation for mapped product identities.

OIDC discovery, follows no redirects, accepts no symmetric JWT algorithms and
never uses email/name claims for ownership.

files.purpose: Strict isolated OBJ+PNG texturedGLB packaging CLI
files.module_docstring:
Strict OBJ + PNG to self-contained textured GLB 2.0 packaging.

This utility exists for isolated model adapters such as the TripoSR candidate.
It intentionally accepts only the simple, single-mesh OBJ shape emitted by
xatlas-python's export helper: one position/UV (and optional normal) index per
vertex and triangular positive-index faces. It does not load MTL files or any
external resource referenced by the OBJ.

security_findings.finding: Reviewed first-party source has no newly introduced arbitrary installer hook, obfuscated execution or credential-exfiltration destination relative to known56f412f source; operator-selected upstream/JWKS/S3 endpoints are explicit boundaries. This is not proof of account security or vulnerability absence.
GLB verification is intentionally structural; no full accessor/extension/decodedrenderer-resource policy or topology/visual validation. Third-party renderer safety is not guaranteed.
security_findings.recommendation: Define supportedglTFextensions and decoded-resource budgets before broad untrustedasset acceptance; validate real downstream imports.

security_findings.finding: Owner gateway validates upload signature and size after multipart spooling, unlike tenantAPI preparse BodyLimitMiddleware and full image normalization. It must remain privateoperator-only.
security_findings.recommendation: Retain perimeter/private boundary; extend preparse limits if usage scope expands.

security_findings.finding: At56f412f gatewayDocker installed without CPUconstraints usedbyAPI. This task changes gatewayDocker/Compose to rootcontext and commonrequirements.lock, preservingoriginals. Mutable pythonbase/setuptoolsminimum/directcandidatepins still do not form artifactintegritylock.
security_findings.recommendation: ValidatebuiltCPUimage; retain separateGPUruntime and complete artifacthashreview before productionqualification.

security_findings.finding: Filesystem inventory gathers candidates using list+rglob before enforcing returned objectlimit. Reporting fails closed on truncation, but discovery memory is not strictly bounded by max_objects. Scanner compares owner/size metadata, not everyobject contenthash.
security_findings.recommendation: Consider streaming deterministic traversal and separate opt-in contentverification at higher scale; do not describe currentinventory as comprehensive byteaudit.

security_findings.finding: Preparation verifies exactGitcommit and sixmodifiedsourceblobs, but full transitive artifacts and actual checkpoint/headlessbake/container compatibility remain open; source copy can include ignored local files because clean Gitstatus doesnot enumerate ignoredcontent.
security_findings.recommendation: Use fresh exact upstreamcheckout, inspect fullpreparedcontext, and add ignoredcontent boundary before productionqualification; no inferenceauthorized.
